items.title: Elf with a Basket of Blue Berries
items.alt: Small brown-eyed cartoon elf in a green capelet holding a wicker basket of blue berries, with a loose sprig beside the shoes.
items.description: Both hands rest on the basket's curved handle. A strawberry-blond fringe, red bell-tipped cap and short green capelet distinguish the compact standing character.

items.title: Elf Blowing Soap Bubbles
items.alt: Curly-haired cartoon elf seated on a wooden stool with a red bubble wand, a small cup and three floating bubbles.
items.description: Three iridescent bubbles rise beside the elf's open smile. A cream-trimmed curled green hat and flared green skirt surround the little seated figure.

items.title: Elf Pushing a Decorative Mushroom Cart
items.alt: Silver-haired cartoon elf in a green dress pushing a little wooden cart filled with three colorful spotted mushrooms.
items.description: Red, green and ochre mushroom caps rise above a bow-decorated wooden cart. The elf leans on its handle in a cream blouse, green dress and red lace-up shoes.

items.title: Elf Holding a Wooden Hive Frame
items.alt: Violet-eyed cartoon elf in green overalls holding an empty wooden frame beside a small slatted hive box.
items.description: The rectangular frame rests across the elf's hands above an open wooden box. A red shirt, scalloped green shorts and a star-tipped cap keep the workshop character distinctly festive.

items.title: Elf Painting a Holly Card
items.alt: Dark-haired cartoon elf seated cross-legged and painting holly leaves and red berries on a cream card.
items.description: A small red paint jar sits beside the elf's curled shoes. The brush meets a berry on the card, held above green-striped stockings and a cream-trimmed coat.

items.title: Elf Shaping a Clay Bird
items.alt: Auburn-haired cartoon elf in a green outfit shaping a little clay bird on a low wooden pottery wheel.
items.description: Clay-coated hands cup the bird's rounded body while its beak and wing remain clearly visible. A red folded cap and gold-buckled green tunic frame the small pottery scene.
